classification.scenario_policy_reason: For a mid-rise office in Metro Manila, green design should begin with tropical load reduction: shade, ventilation where appropriate, envelope control, water efficiency, and indoor environmental quality. Documentation can then map those decisions to the Green Building Code scope and, if pursued, to BERDE categories.
